# 🎬 Book & Movie Recommendation Bot

I'll create an interactive recommendation bot that helps you discover new entertainment based on your preferences!

from typing import List, Dict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

class Category(Enum):
    BOOK = "book"
    MOVIE = "movie"
    SERIES = "series"
    GAME = "game"
    MUSIC = "music"

@dataclass
class Recommendation:
    title: str
    category: Category
    description: str
    rating: float

# Sample database of entertainment items
